Bonjour,

I would like to display some information about the progress of a code that take long time to finish.

messages.subject: Re: Show the change of text in verbatimTextOutput() while code runs
parts:
Outputs currently always work this way. However, we have other messaging mechanisms that don't wait. It looks like in your case, you're trying to do something similar to what I did with progress indicators in the shiny-incubator package:

https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-incubator

You can install it with:

devtools::install_github("shiny-incubator", "rstudio")

Then see ?shinyIncubator::withProgress

Note that somewhere in your UI (doesn't matter where, as long as it's in the page) you will need to include progressInit().
